# vastdata_de_mtls_authentication_credential (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Data Engine mTLS credentials used when attaching a Kubernetes cluster.
# Requires vastdata_de_engine to be completed first.
#
# Provide exactly one of:
#   A) kubeconfig_data (+ optional context_name) — write-only, not stored in state
#   B) certificate_authority_b64 + client_certificate_b64 + client_key_b64

provider "vastdata" {
  host     = "vast-cluster"
  username = "admin"
  password = "******"
}

# --- Option A: kubeconfig + context -------------------------------------------
resource "vastdata_de_mtls_authentication_credential" "from_kubeconfig" {
  name            = "de-mtls"
  tenant_name     = "de-lab" # required for cluster-admin auth
  kubeconfig_data = file("${path.module}/kubeconfig")
  context_name    = "my-cluster-context" # optional; defaults to current-context
}

# --- Option B: explicit base64 PEMs -------------------------------------------
resource "vastdata_de_mtls_authentication_credential" "from_pems" {
  name                      = "de-mtls-pems"
  tenant_name               = "de-lab"
  certificate_authority_b64 = filebase64("${path.module}/ca.crt")
  client_certificate_b64    = filebase64("${path.module}/client.crt")
  client_key_b64            = filebase64("${path.module}/client.key")
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A name for the resource.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `certificate_authority_b64` (String, Sensitive) Base64-encoded CA certificate used to verify the identity of the Kubernetes API server.
It ensures that the client is communicating with the legitimate Kubernetes API server by validating the server's certificate.
- `client_certificate_b64` (String, Sensitive) Base64-encoded X.509 certificate for the client.
It works in conjunction with the client-key-data to authenticate the user to the Kubernetes API server.
This certificate is typically issued by a trusted Certificate Authority (CA).
- `client_key_b64` (String, Sensitive) Base64-encoded private key associated with a client certificate.
It is used by the Kubernetes client (e.g., kubectl) to prove its identity to the API server when making requests.
This key must remain confidential and secure.
- `context_name` (String) Kubeconfig context to use with kubeconfig_data. Defaults to current-context. Ignored when certificate_*_b64 fields are set directly.
- `description` (String) A description of the resource.
- `kubeconfig_data` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Raw kubeconfig YAML. Alternative to certificate_authority_b64 / client_certificate_b64 / client_key_b64. Parsed on create/update when set; never stored in state.
- `tags` (Set of String) Custom tags for organizing and categorizing resources in the GUI.
- `tenant_name` (String) Tenant name for Data Engine API queries. Required for cluster-admin auth; optional when the provider already authenticates as that tenant.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created.
- `guid` (String) A globally unique identifier (GUID) for the resource.
- `id` (Number) A globally unique identifier (ID) for the resource.
- `owner` (Attributes) Represents the owner of the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))
- `tenant_guid` (String) A globally unique identifier (GUID) for the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated.
- `vrn` (String) A logical path for resource grouping and policy assignment. The structure of the logical path is: vast:dataengine:<resource type>:<custom structure per type>
where resource type is one of: triggers / functions / pipelines / topics / kubernetes-clusters / container-registries / mtls-authentication-credentials.
